summary.name: Flying Roadster AI
summary.one_liner: A browser tool that turns one selfie (or a selfie plus a car photo) into a ~10-second 9:16 AI video of a car jumping a night ramp, flipping, and landing with sound.
keywords: make flying car video from photo
use_cases: Making a viral flying-car meme clip from a selfie
Creating a vertical stunt video for TikTok, Reels or Shorts
Turning a photo of your own car into a flying-over-traffic video
Producing a short AI-generated clip with original sound
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser-only generator with no app and no prompt writing. The user uploads one clear selfie, or adds a selfie and a whole-vehicle photo in the Your Car mode. The output is a locked ~10-second 9:16 MP4 with AI-generated sound, showing a jam, rocket boosters firing, an aerial flip and a white-smoke landing. Packs are one-time purchases of credits, with 720p renders costing 500 credits and 480p renders 375 credits. The page says the output has no watermark and that renders usually take a few minutes.
notable: Locked jam-to-rocket-to-flip scene from one selfie, no prompt writing or editing app needed
One-time credit packs ($8.88, $16.99, $29.90) with no subscription and no account required per Stripe checkout
Your Car mode fly a whole-vehicle photo using a generic car with badges blanked
caveats: Paid: from $8.88 per one-time credit pack; the page says it is not a free generator
Built for adults 18+ and requires a clear selfie of the user or a consenting friend
Independent fan tool, not affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or CapCut; the page asks users to label output as AI-generated and never attempt it on real roads
